## Conceptos principales

<div class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="1" style="margin-top: 50px; overflow-x: auto;">
<table style="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 28px;">
<thead>
<tr style="background: #1e3a5f; color: white;">
<th class="pad-10 text-left">Concepto</th>
<th class="pad-10 text-left">Definición</th>
<th class="pad-10 text-left">Notación</th>
<th class="pad-10 text-left">Ejemplo (bovinos, Huila)</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="2" style="background: #faf5ff;">
<td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; font-weight: bold; color: #a78bfa;">Experimento aleatorio</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Resultado incierto bajo condiciones fijas</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">,</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Clasificar estado hídrico y sanitario</td>
</tr>
<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="3">
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200 text-bold text-blue">Espacio muestral</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Todos los resultados posibles</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">$\Omega$</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">$\{(H,S),(H,P),(H,F),(E,S),(E,P),(E,F)\}$</td>
</tr>
<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="4" style="background: #f0fdf4;">
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200 text-bold text-green">Evento</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Subconjunto de $\Omega$</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">$A, B, \ldots$</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">"animal sana": $\{(H,S),(E,S)\}$</td>
</tr>
<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="5">
<td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; font-weight: bold; color: #F28E2B;">Unión</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Al menos uno ocurre</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">$A \cup B$</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Sana o bien hidratada</td>
</tr>
<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="6" style="background: #fdf2f8;">
<td style="padding: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; font-weight: bold; color: #B07AA1;">Intersección</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Ambos ocurren</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">$A \cap B$</td>
<td class="pad-8 bb-gray200">Sana y bien hidratada</td>
</tr>
<tr class="fragment fade-up" data-fragment-index="7" style="background: #f0f9ff;">
<td style="padding: 8px; font-weight: bold; color: #76B7B2;">Complemento</td>
<td class="pad-8">Todo lo que no está en $A$</td>
<td class="pad-8">$A^c$</td>
<td class="pad-8">No sana = $\{(H,P),(H,F),(E,P),(E,F)\}$</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
